headline: Premier League MW6: Coventry beat Newcastle 4-1
whyCareReason: ESPN and Sky list Coventry's first Premier League home win in 25 years. Coventry climb to 14th on 6 points. Newcastle stay 11th on 8.
teaser: Rudoni 6 (pen), Cherif 48, Botman 70, Simms 81, Mfuni 86. Half-time was 1-0 at the Coventry Building Society Arena.
story: Coventry City beat Newcastle United 4-1 on Monday at the Coventry Building Society Arena. Jack Rudoni scored a sixth-minute penalty, Sidiki Cherif scored in the 48th minute, Sven Botman in the 70th, Ellis Simms in the 81st and Stephen Mfuni in the 86th. Half-time was 1-0. Frank Lampard is Coventry's manager. Coventry have 6 points from 6 games (2-0-4, 5 for and 11 against) and sit 14th. Newcastle have 8 points from 6 games (2-2-2, 10 for and 13 against) and stay 11th. Manchester City still lead with 18 points.
stakes: The win lifts Coventry level on points with Manchester United, behind them on goal difference. Newcastle stay a point above Crystal Palace.
rivalryAngle: A Monday night at the bottom of Matchweek 6, after City's 3-0 at Anfield had already set the top.
funFacts: Scorers: Rudoni 6 (pen), Cherif 48, Botman 70, Simms 81, Mfuni 86. Half-time 1-0.
